marketMood: Risk-on with caveats: cooler-than-expected US CPI slashes Fed hike bets and lifts equities broadly, but Brent crude surges past $85 as US-Iran strikes escalate and China's Q2 GDP misses target for the first time since COVID.

upcomingEvents.event: US housing starts & industrial production data
Bank of Japan policy meeting + quarterly outlook (rate hike watch)

topStories.headline: US June CPI Falls for First Time Since 2020, Slashing Fed Hike Bets
topStories.summary: Consumer prices dropped 0.4% in June, dragging the annual rate to 3.5% from May's 4.2%, with core CPI at 2.6% — both well below expectations — cutting the odds of a July Fed hike from 42% to 17%.
topStories.marketImpact: ↑ S&P 500 (+0.38% to 7,572), ↑ Nasdaq (+0.62% to 26,269); ↑ Treasuries (10Y yield fell to ~4.57%); ↑ rate-sensitive tech; ↓ dollar

topStories.headline: US Launches New Iran Strikes, Reinstates Naval Blockade Over Strait of Hormuz
topStories.summary: US Central Command conducted a seven-hour airstrike operation targeting Iranian military assets near the Strait of Hormuz and reimposed a naval blockade, with Iran's IRGC threatening to cut off regional energy exports; tanker transits fell to a two-month low.
topStories.marketImpact: ↑ Brent crude (~$85/barrel), ↑ WTI (~$80/barrel); ↑ XOM, CVX; ↓ oil-importing Asian economies; geopolitical risk watch

topStories.headline: China Approves Apple Intelligence Powered by Alibaba's Qwen AI
topStories.summary: China's Cyberspace Administration approved Apple Intelligence for mainland iPhones and Macs, with Alibaba's Qwen AI model integrated across iOS, iPadOS, and macOS — Apple's AI had been absent from China since its 2024 debut.
topStories.marketImpact: ↑ AAPL (+4%, new all-time high); ↑ BABA ADRs (+5%); ↑ 9988.HK; broadens Apple's China revenue opportunity after a market-share squeeze from Huawei and Xiaomi

topStories.headline: US Bank Earnings Season Delivers Profit Bonanza; Morgan Stanley Posts Records Across the Board
topStories.summary: Morgan Stanley reported record Q2 net revenues of $21.3B (+27% YoY) and EPS of $3.46, with equities trading up 69% YoY and a new $20B buyback; JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs, BofA, and Citigroup also beat estimates earlier in the week on elevated trading revenues from geopolitical volatility.
topStories.marketImpact: ↑ MS, JPM, GS, BAC, C; financials sector outperformed broader market; Goldman highlighted SpaceX IPO advisory fees

topStories.headline: Chip Stocks Retreat as Valuation Concerns Weigh on Semiconductor Sector
topStories.summary: Micron fell 8%, Lam Research dropped 3%, and AMD slid 3% as investors reassessed semiconductor valuations following a near-tripling for many names in Q2; mega-cap tech stocks (Amazon, Alphabet, Microsoft +~3%) held gains on the softer rate outlook.
topStories.marketImpact: ↓ MU (-8%), ↓ LRCX (-3%), ↓ AMD (-3%); ↑ AMZN, GOOGL, MSFT (+3%); rotation from semis toward large-cap software

topStories.headline: China Q2 GDP Slows to 4.3%, Missing Target for First Time Since COVID
topStories.summary: China's Q2 GDP expanded 4.3% year-on-year — the slowest pace since 2022 — missing the 4.5% consensus and the government's 5% annual target; fixed-asset investment fell 5.7% and June retail sales rose only 1.0%, underscoring domestic demand fragility despite record exports.
topStories.marketImpact: ↓ FXI; ↓ 9988.HK, ↓ 0700.HK; commodity currencies (AUD, NZD) under pressure; watch for Beijing stimulus signals

topStories.headline: China June Exports Hit Record $412bn as AI Boom and Tariff Rush Drive Trade Surge
topStories.summary: China's exports surged 27% year-on-year to a record $412.4 billion in June, widening the trade surplus to $125.6 billion — the second-largest on record — driven by AI hardware demand and front-loading ahead of potential US tariff hikes; vehicle exports exceeded 1 million units in a single month for the first time.
topStories.marketImpact: ↑ Chinese exporters; ↑ FXI; yuan/CNH firming; watch for US tariff response given surplus widening

topStories.headline: Nikkei Surges Past 68,300 as Tech Stocks Rally; Kioxia Dethrones Toyota as Japan's Most Valuable Company
topStories.summary: Japan's Nikkei 225 climbed 0.9% above 68,300, led by AI-related stocks — Kioxia (+6.7%), Lasertec (+6.9%), Advantest (+4.4%), Tokyo Electron (+1.6%) — with Kioxia surpassing Toyota by market cap to become Japan's most valuable listed company; domestic machinery orders fell more than expected, raising BoJ caution.
topStories.marketImpact: ↑ 6600.T (Kioxia), ↑ 6857.T (Advantest), ↑ 6920.T (Lasertec), ↑ 8035.T (Tokyo Electron); watch BoJ July 30–31 meeting for further rate signals after June hike to 1%

topStories.headline: KOSPI Surges 7% to Reclaim 7,000 as SK Hynix Soars 9% on AI Memory Demand
topStories.summary: South Korea's KOSPI jumped ~7% to 7,335 — its strongest session in months — as SK Hynix surged 9.4% and Samsung rose 5.9% on strong AI memory demand and the broader CPI-driven relief rally; the move came after the KOSPI had sold off following SK Hynix's record Nasdaq ADR debut.
topStories.marketImpact: ↑ SKHY, ↑ 000660.KS (SK Hynix +9.4%), ↑ 005930.KS (Samsung +5.9%); AI memory complex broadly repriced higher

companiesToWatch.name: Apple
companiesToWatch.reason: Hit a new all-time high after China approved Apple Intelligence powered by Alibaba's Qwen AI, unlocking the world's largest smartphone market for its AI platform after a two-year absence.

companiesToWatch.name: Alibaba Group
companiesToWatch.reason: ADRs jumped 5% after its Qwen AI was selected as the backbone of Apple Intelligence in China, a landmark enterprise AI partnership that counters the weak domestic demand reflected in the Q2 GDP miss.

companiesToWatch.name: Kioxia Holdings
companiesToWatch.reason: Surged 6.7% to become Japan's most valuable listed company by market cap; booming AI-driven NAND demand and an expected tripling of its TOPIX index weight are drawing institutional flows.

companiesToWatch.name: SK Hynix
companiesToWatch.reason: Seoul shares soared 9.4% after the prior week's Nasdaq ADR sell-off; AI HBM memory demand and NVIDIA partnership fundamentals remain intact, making a stabilisation of SKHY the key watch for US investors.

companiesToWatch.name: Micron Technology
companiesToWatch.reason: Fell 8% as investors reassessed valuations following a near-tripling in Q2 2026; HBM production slowdown signals from SK Hynix add to demand growth uncertainty.

companiesToWatch.name: Chevron
companiesToWatch.reason: In focus as Brent crude surged above $85 on renewed US-Iran strikes and the reimposition of the Strait of Hormuz naval blockade, lifting major integrated oil producers.
